item.title: Self-Hosted OCI Runtime Hooks: umoci vs oci-seccomp-bpf-hook vs oci-add-hooks
item.description: OCI (Open Container Initiative) runtime hooks allow you to execute custom logic at specific points during a container lifecycle — before it starts, after it stops, or during creation. These hooks enable powerful customization: injecting environment variables, setting up network namespaces, applying seccomp profiles dynamically, or mounting filesystems on-the-fly. In this guide, we compare three open-source OCI hook implementations and show you how to deploy each with Docker Compose.
